- [USER] User expressed interest in how Microsoft incorporates its HoloLens mixed reality technology into its products.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Microsoft incorporates its HoloLens mixed reality technology into its products through several means, including:
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] HoloLens Development Kits: Microsoft provides development kits for HoloLens, allowing developers to create applications leveraging mixed reality technology.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] HoloLens Apps: Microsoft has developed apps such as SketchUp Viewer, Microsoft Layout, and Dynamics 365 Remote Assist to enhance productivity, collaboration, and remote assistance.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Azure Spatial Anchors: A cloud-based service enabling developers to build shared experiences across multiple HoloLens devices.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Windows Mixed Reality: A platform allowing users to experience mixed reality content on various devices, including HoloLens and Windows Mixed Reality headsets.
